import sys

def main():
    it = iter(sys.stdin.read().splitlines())
    for n_str in it:
        n = int(n_str)
        s = next(it)
        arr = list(s)
        max_len = 0
        word_count = 0
        cur_len = 0
        i = 0
        while i < n:
            c = arr[i]
            if c == '(':
                if cur_len > max_len:
                    max_len = cur_len
                cur_len = 0
                i += 1
                while i < n and arr[i] != ')':
                    if arr[i] == '_':
                        if cur_len > 0:
                            word_count += 1
                            cur_len = 0
                    elif arr[i] != '(' and arr[i] != ')':
                        cur_len += 1
                    i += 1
                if cur_len > 0:
                    word_count += 1
                    cur_len = 0
                i += 1
            elif c == '_':
                if cur_len > max_len:
                    max_len = cur_len
                cur_len = 0
                i += 1
            elif c == ')':
                i += 1
            else:
                cur_len += 1
                i += 1
        if cur_len > max_len:
            max_len = cur_len
        print(f"{max_len} {word_count}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
